---
name: clip-review
description: "Review generated clips for motion, sound and sync, or collect batch keep/refine/drop feedback."
---

## Batch feedback

When the clip review widget is available, for a batch of more than six clips, present each one, then show the saved widget
`voyager.clip-review` with `presentation: "inline"` (one entry per clip: a unique `id`,
`number`, `title`, and its presented-file id as `assetRef`) so the user reviews them in the
chat, one after another in a single column instead of file by file; its submission lists each
clip's keep/refine/drop verdict and the note on each refine.

## Widget files

| Widget | Files | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Clip review | [manifest](assets/clip-review/definition.json), [spec](assets/clip-review/spec.json) | `voyager.clip-review`: batch review of presented clips, one after another in a single column with number and name: keep, refine with a note, or drop each, sent as one structured review. Show it with `presentation: "inline"`, a unique `id`, `number` and `title` per clip, and `assetRef` set to its presented-file id. |
